subject: Re: COLA status: probe numbers + pipeline risk
body:
Team,

Decision from today's review: we ship frozen-encoder embeddings as the platform offering. Vera's numbers (93.8 linear probe vs 95.4 fine-tuned on SPCV2) put frozen inside our quality bar, and one backbone is the whole point of a platform. Wake-word and audio-events teams can fine-tune downstream at their own serving cost — we'll document the DS recipe but not host the variants.

Halima confirmed the audio dataset registrations completed on v2 yesterday, ahead of the Corpus v2 freeze this Friday, so we're clear on the platform dependency.

Remaining: Leilani drives the embedding-service integration through July; Wei owns the eval card in Evalline. Launch review target stays mid-July.

Thanks all,
Dmitri
